response.justification: Bogdan has over 12 years of full-stack experience with deep proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS CDK, aligning closely with the required stack. His work on AI-agent infrastructure, testing frameworks, and containerized systems demonstrates strong architectural and automation skills. His open-source contributions and teaching experience reflect leadership and communication strengths, though his German language skill is basic, which may slightly limit local collaboration.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and AWS
Proven track record in AI-agent development and internal tooling
Strong testing culture and open-source contributions (Vitest, DLang libraries)
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, potentially limiting local team integration
Limited explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest in resume, though equivalents are present
Some roles involve legacy or niche tech (DLang, Ember.js) which may raise questions about modern stack focus
